instruction: Reflect the yellow triangle horizontally so its left and right sides are swapped.

metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting the yellow triangle and flipping it horizontally. The evaluator checks if the triangle has been mirrored from left to right by comparing the centroid's horizontal position - after flipping, the triangle should be on the opposite side of the image. Custom metric function check_triangle_flipped__0293a54ed09c3032ba177ba116651a07 finds the triangle using color-based segmentation and verifies that its horizontal position has changed significantly (moved to the opposite side).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete baseline verification: Function loads original image from /home/user/Desktop/Triangle_On_The_Side.png and verifies (1) triangle was originally on left side (< width/3), (2) triangle is now on right side (> 2*width/3), (3) triangle moved across center (movement > width/3).

Proper flip/mirroring verification: Function implements pixel-level mirror verification using _verify_horizontal_mirror() which creates horizontally flipped version of original using np.fliplr() and compares it to result image with threshold avg_diff < 30 to handle compression artifacts.

Expected parameter correctly used: Function reads expected['orientation'] and implements logic based on it - supports both 'flipped_horizontal' and 'flipped_vertical' orientations, making the function configurable.

Robust edge case handling: Function handles missing original file with fallback _check_result_only(), handles RGBA vs RGB conversion, verifies yellow triangle detection with fallback color detection, and returns appropriate scores.

Complete verification coverage: All 4 conditions must be met for horizontal flip: (1) originally on left, (2) now on right, (3) moved across center, (4) pixel-level mirroring verified. This ensures the triangle was actually flipped, not just moved.
